messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "0.6 mg for each kilogram of body weight"
set: ["0.6 mg for each kilogram of body weight", "1 mg for each kilogram of body weight once a day", "1 mg to 2 mg per kilogram of body weight a day", "0.02% body weight loss after two years", "0.43% body weight loss after one year", "2.1% body weight loss after two years", "2.7% body weight loss after one year", "use for weight management", "5 mg subcutaneously once weekly for weight loss", "15 mg subcutaneously once weekly for weight loss", "10 mg subcutaneously once weekly for weight loss", "up to 3 mg per kilogram (1.5 mg per pound) a day", "21% of their weight", "no loss of body fat", "breakdown of clopidogrel in body", "other parts of the body"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
